Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills
